tmb_28.confound: Pooled HR 0.726 (p=0.005) is a pooled-cohort artifact: every individual study is null and TCGA goes the opposite direction (HR 1.13). Likely immortal-time bias (MSK-IMPACT sequencing requires survival, enriching high-TMB with indolent/MSI-H tumors) + stage-mix differences. An independent 21-study CRC cohort (n_hi=259) gave HR 0.933, p=0.47 (null).
tmb_28.honest_read: Tissue TMB is NOT prognostic for OS in unselected CRC; it is predictive only in the checkpoint-inhibitor context. Do NOT cite the pooled HR 0.726 as a protective effect or as refuting the prior underpowered null.
